🌍 World of Nations (formerly Project Nation)

🆕 THE 1444 UPDATE!
• NEW map: 1444, the Age of Crowns, with 237 realms
• 59 big focus trees for 1444, true to history
• New focus rewards: dynastic alliances, monopolies, voyages, tribute
• NEW What If? Russia pass: the Empire of the Romans, Russian America or the Great Game
• Alliances of up to 15 nations, new formables

🗺️ Pick from 200+ nations in 1444, 1914, 1938 or the modern world
🤝 Make allies, draw your battle plans, carve up the peace
⚔️ Justify a war goal, declare war, annex or puppet
🗳️ Up to 12 players, rounds of up to 2.5 hours, then vote on the next map

🏛️ Join our community: World of Nations HQ
👍 Like & Favorite!

Historical borders of the 1444 map adapted from Cliopatria (Seshat Global History Databank), licensed CC BY 4.0. Changes were made: simplified, fitted to the game's grid and edited by hand. Full credit with links: in the game's Settings, under Credits.
